mapper.sql: SELECT cp.id, cp.currency_pair_definition_id, cp.brand_id, b.code AS brand_code, bc.code AS base_currency_code, qc.code AS quote_currency_code, cp.rate_type, cp.rate, cp.active, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at FROM currency_pair cp JOIN brand b ON b.id = cp.brand_id JOIN currency_pair_definition d ON d.id = cp.currency_pair_definition_id JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = d.base_currency_id JOIN currency qc ON qc.id = d.quote_currency_id
mapper.select: SELECT b.code FROM currency_pair cp JOIN brand b ON b.id = cp.brand_id WHERE cp.currency_pair_definition_id = #{definitionId} AND cp.active = TRUE ORDER BY b.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_pair (currency_pair_definition_id, brand_id, rate_type, rate, active) VALUES (#{currencyPairDefinitionId}, #{brandId}, #{rateType}, #{rate}, #{active})
